rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
You must be 18 years of age or older to use the APIs. You also will not use the
Services as part of a website, application, or other service (collectively,
"**API Clients**") that is directed towards or is likely to be accessed by
individuals under the age of 18.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Age Requirements; applies to API and use of Services as part of an API Client.
rules.condition_explanation: user_is_at_least_18 means the person using the APIs is at least 18 years old. api_client_not_directed_to_or_likely_accessed_by_under_18s means the Services are not used as part of a website, application, or other service directed toward or likely to be accessed by individuals under 18.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
Use of Google AI Studio and Gemini API is for developers building with Google AI
models for professional or business purposes, not for consumer use.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; applies to Google AI Studio and Gemini API use.
rules.condition_explanation: professional_or_business_purpose_not_consumer_use means use is for developers building with Google AI models for professional or business purposes, and not for consumer use.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
You may only access the Services (or make API Clients available to users) within
an [available region](/docs/available-regions). **You may use
only Paid Services when making API Clients available to users in the European
Economic Area, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom.**
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; region availability is specified by external Documentation. The Paid Services definition at lines 113–120 determines the relevant service classification.
rules.condition_explanation: within_available_region means the Services are accessed, and any API Clients made available to users are made available, only within an available region. eea_switzerland_or_uk means the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom. If API Clients are made available to users in any of those places, only Paid Services may be used. Paid Services classification depends on the conditions in lines 113–120.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
You may not use the Services to develop models that compete with the Services
(e.g., Gemini API or Google AI Studio). You also may not attempt to reverse
engineer, extract or replicate any component of the Services, including the
underlying data or models (e.g., parameter weights).
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; covers developing models that compete with Services and attempting to reverse engineer, extract, or replicate any Service component, including underlying data or models such as parameter weights.
rules.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to either competing-model development or an attempt to reverse engineer, extract, or replicate a Service component.

obligation_items.content: Do not develop models that compete with the Services or attempt to reverse engineer, extract, or replicate any component of the Services.
obligation_items.object: Services, including underlying data and models
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the Services.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
In addition to the
"[API Prohibitions](https://developers.google.com/terms#a_api_prohibitions)"
section in the API Terms, you must comply with our
[Prohibited Use Policy](https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy),
which provides additional details about appropriate conduct when using the
Services.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; incorporates the API Terms' API Prohibitions and the linked Prohibited Use Policy. Their substantive content is not supplied.
rules.condition_explanation: comply_with_api_prohibitions_and_prohibited_use_policy means compliance with both the API Prohibitions section of the API Terms and the linked Prohibited Use Policy; their requirements cannot be determined from this chunk.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the API Terms' API Prohibitions and the Prohibited Use Policy.
obligation_items.object: use of the Services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the Services.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
The Services include safety features to block harmful content, such as content
that violates our
[Prohibited Use Policy](https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy).
You may not attempt to bypass these protective measures or use content that
violates the API Terms or these Additional Terms. You are responsible for
determining the necessary and appropriate [safety settings](/docs/safety-settings)
and factuality tools for your use case. Applications with less restrictive
safety settings may be subject to Google's review and approval.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; includes a prohibition on bypassing protective measures or using content violating the API Terms or Additional Terms, plus a safety-settings responsibility and a review/approval caveat for less restrictive settings.
rules.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies if either protective measures are bypassed or content violating the referenced terms is used. The separate responsibility to determine necessary and appropriate safety settings and factuality tools is stated as a duty, but cannot be represented as a distinct activity in the supplied activity vocabulary. Google review and approval may apply to applications with less restrictive safety settings; no approval outcome is supplied.

obligation_items.content: Do not attempt to bypass protective measures or use content that violates the API Terms or Additional Terms.
obligation_items.object: Services and content used with the Services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the Services.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
You may not use the Services in clinical practice, to provide medical advice, or
in any manner that is overseen by or requires clearance or approval from a
medical device regulatory agency.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; bars the stated medical and regulated uses of the Services.
rules.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies if use is in clinical practice, to provide medical advice, or in any manner overseen by or requiring clearance or approval from a medical device regulatory agency.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the Services in clinical practice, to provide medical advice, or in a manner overseen by or requiring medical-device regulatory clearance or approval.
obligation_items.object: Services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the Services.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
As required by the API Terms, you'll comply with applicable law in using
generated content, which may require the provision of
[attribution](https://ai.google.dev/api/rest/v1beta/CitationMetadata) to your
users when returned as part of an API call. Use discretion before relying on
generated content,
including [code](https://g.co/legal/generative-code). You're responsible for
your use of generated content, and for the use of that content by anyone you
share it with.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use of Generated Content; the applicable-law duty is stated to be required by the API Terms. Attribution may be required by applicable law when generated content is returned as part of an API call. User discretion and responsibility statements are also included.
rules.condition_explanation: The operative compliance duty is to comply with applicable law in using generated content, including attribution only where applicable law requires it. The API Terms are external and not supplied. The text also assigns responsibility for the licensee's use and for use by recipients with whom content is shared, without specifying a separately expressible activity duty.

obligation_items.content: Comply with applicable law when using generated content, including providing attribution to users when applicable law requires it for content returned as part of an API call.
obligation_items.object: generated content
obligation_items.trigger: When using generated content; attribution is required only when applicable law requires it in the stated API-call context.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
When you use Unpaid Services, including, for example, Google AI Studio and the
unpaid quota on Gemini API, Google uses the content you submit to the Services
and any generated responses to provide, improve, and develop Google products and
services and machine learning technologies, including Google's enterprise
features, products, and services, consistent with our
[Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; describes Google's use of submitted content and generated responses, subject to the linked Privacy Policy. This is a provider data-processing commitment, not a licensee activity permission or duty expressible with the supplied activities.
rules.condition_explanation: unpaid_service_use includes Google AI Studio and unpaid Gemini API quota. The stated purposes are to provide, improve, and develop Google products, services, and machine-learning technologies, including enterprise features. The linked Privacy Policy is not supplied.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
To help with quality and improve our products, human reviewers may read,
annotate, and process your API input and output. Google takes steps to protect
your privacy as part of this process. This includes disconnecting this data from
your Google Account, API key, and Cloud project before reviewers see or annotate
it. **Do not submit sensitive, confidential, or personal information to the
Unpaid Services.**
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; expressly directs users not to submit sensitive, confidential, or personal information to Unpaid Services.
rules.condition_explanation: unpaid_service_use means use of an Unpaid Service, including Google AI Studio or unpaid Gemini API quota. The prohibition applies to submission of any sensitive, confidential, or personal information.

obligation_items.content: Do not submit sensitive, confidential, or personal information to Unpaid Services.
obligation_items.object: input submitted to Unpaid Services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using Unpaid Services.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
The license you grant to Google under the
"[Submission of Content](https://developers.google.com/terms#b_submission_of_content)"
section in the API Terms also extends, to the extent required under applicable
law for our use, to any content (e.g., prompts, including associated system
instructions, cached content, and files such as images, videos, or documents)
you submit to the Services and to any generated responses.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; describes an extension of the license granted to Google under the API Terms' Submission of Content section. The incorporated grant and its operative scope are not supplied, so no permission or duty is inferred.
rules.condition_explanation: The extension applies to the extent required under applicable law for Google's use and covers submitted content, including examples of prompts, associated system instructions, cached content, and files, as well as generated responses. The API Terms' underlying license is missing.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
Google only uses content that you import or upload to our model tuning feature
for that express purpose. Tuning content may be retained in connection with your
tuned models for purposes of re-tuning when supported models change. When you
delete a tuned model, the related tuning content is also deleted.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; describes Google's purpose limitation and retention/deletion behavior for tuning content. These provider data-handling statements do not map to an available activity without inventing one.
rules.condition_explanation: The stated use is only for the express tuning purpose. Tuning content may be retained with tuned models for re-tuning when supported models change, and related tuning content is deleted when the tuned model is deleted.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
If you're in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom, the
terms under "[How Google uses Your Data](/docs/terms#data-use-paid)" in
"[Paid Services](/docs/terms#paid-services)" apply to all Services, including Google AI
Studio and unpaid quota in the Gemini API, even though they are offered free of
charge.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; for users in the EEA, Switzerland, or UK, the Paid Services data-use terms apply to all Services, including otherwise unpaid Google AI Studio and Gemini API quota. The referenced Paid Services section is at lines 128–153.
rules.condition_explanation: user_in_eea_switzerland_or_uk means the user is in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or United Kingdom. This clause incorporates the Paid Services data-use provisions; it does not itself specify a distinct user action or additional data duty.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
When a Service is being offered for a fee, it is considered to be a paid Service
(the "**Paid Services**"). Your access to Google AI Studio is a "Paid Service"
even when it is offered free of charge, as long as the account you are using to
access Google AI Studio has access to a Cloud Project with an associated and
active [Cloud Billing account](https://cloud.google.com/billing/docs/concepts)
or is a Workspace enterprise account.
Your access to Gemini API is a "Paid Service" only when accessing the API
through a Cloud Project associated with an active billing account.
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Paid Services; defines when access is treated as a Paid Service, a classification used by other terms rather than an independent permission or obligation.
rules.condition_explanation: A fee-offered Service is Paid. Google AI Studio access is also Paid when the account has access to a Cloud Project with an associated active Cloud Billing account or is a Workspace enterprise account, even if offered free. Gemini API access is Paid only through a Cloud Project associated with an active billing account.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
For Paid Services, "Google" as used in these
Terms has the meaning given
[here](https://cloud.google.com/terms/google-entity).
rules.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Paid Services; cross-reference defining which Google entity the term Google denotes. The referenced entity definition is external and not supplied.
rules.condition_explanation: For Paid Services, Google has the meaning in the linked Google Cloud Terms entity definition. This definition supplies context only and does not itself create a behavioral rule.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
"**Fees**" (as used in the
[Google Cloud Terms of Service](https://cloud.google.com/terms)) for
Paid Services are as specified on our [pricing](/docs/pricing) page. Google may make
changes to this pricing from time to time, effective 30 days after they are
posted unless otherwise specified (or in the case of new Paid Services, where
pricing takes effect immediately unless otherwise specified). Your continued
use of the Paid Services constitutes your consent to those changes.
rules.scope_note: Applies to continued use of Paid Services after Google posts a pricing change. Pricing changes generally take effect 30 days after posting unless otherwise specified; pricing for new Paid Services takes effect immediately unless otherwise specified. The actual prices and any alternative effective dates are not supplied.
rules.condition_explanation: continued_use_of_paid_services_after_pricing_change means the licensee continues using Paid Services after Google posts a pricing change. The clause records the stated consent consequence, not a separate duty to continue using the services.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
When using agentic services, including the Computer Use API, you are solely
responsible for the actions and tasks performed by the service, such as
determining whether the service is appropriate for your use case, authorizing
the service's access and connection to data, applications, and systems, and
exercising judgment and supervision when and if the service is used in
production environments. You will not automatically bypass any requests for
human confirmation.
rules.scope_note: Applies when using agentic services, including the Computer Use API. The licensee is assigned responsibility for actions and tasks performed by the service, including the listed suitability, authorization, judgment, and supervision matters; automatic bypass of human-confirmation requests is prohibited.
rules.condition_explanation: using_agentic_services means using an agentic service, including the Computer Use API. The positive requirements are conjunctive; the prohibition on automatically bypassing confirmation requests applies whenever the service is used.

obligation_items.content: Determine whether the agentic service is appropriate for the licensee's use case.
obligation_items.object: agentic service use
obligation_items.trigger: when using an agentic service

obligation_items.content: Authorize the agentic service's access and connection to data, applications, and systems.
obligation_items.object: data, applications, and systems accessed or connected by the agentic service
obligation_items.trigger: when the agentic service is given access to or connected with data, applications, or systems

obligation_items.content: Exercise judgment and supervision when and if the agentic service is used in production environments.
obligation_items.object: agentic service in production environments
obligation_items.trigger: when and if the agentic service is used in a production environment

obligation_items.content: Do not automatically bypass any request for human confirmation.
obligation_items.object: human-confirmation requests encountered by the agentic service
obligation_items.trigger: when using an agentic service and a human-confirmation request is presented

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*   You will only use Grounding with Google Search in an application that is owned
  and operated by you and will only display the Grounded Results with the
  associated Search Suggestion(s) to the end user who submitted the prompt.
rules.scope_note: Applies to use of Grounding with Google Search. Use is limited to an application owned and operated by the licensee, and display of Grounded Results with associated Search Suggestions is limited to the end user who submitted the prompt.
rules.condition_explanation: using_grounding_with_google_search means using the Grounding with Google Search service. Both the application-ownership condition and the specified display-recipient restriction apply.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Grounding with Google Search in an application that is not owned and operated by the licensee.
obligation_items.object: Grounding with Google Search service
obligation_items.trigger: whenever the licensee uses Grounding with Google Search

obligation_items.content: Do not display Grounded Results or their associated Search Suggestions to anyone other than the end user who submitted the prompt.
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results and associated Search Suggestions
obligation_items.trigger: when displaying Grounded Results and associated Search Suggestions

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*   You will not, and will not allow your end user or any third party to, cache,
  frame, syndicate, resell, analyze, train on, or otherwise learn from
  Grounded Results or Search Suggestions. For clarity, Grounded Results, Search
  Suggestions, and Links are intended to be used in combination to respond to a
  given end user prompt and it is a violation of these terms to use Grounding
  with Google Search to extract or collect one or more of these components for
  another purpose (for example, using programmatic or automated means to collect
  Links, using Links to build an index, or using Links to identify destination
  pages for crawling or scraping).
rules.actor_role: licensee, end users, and third parties whom the licensee allows
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, and Links. Prohibits caching, framing, syndicating, reselling, analyzing, training on, or otherwise learning from Grounded Results or Search Suggestions; also prohibits extracting or collecting any of those components for another purpose, including the specified automated collection, indexing, crawling, or scraping examples.
rules.condition_explanation: grounded_results_or_search_suggestions_or_links means the identified Search grounding components; the specific extraction prohibition also covers Links.

obligation_items.content: Do not cache, frame, syndicate, resell, analyze, train on, or otherwise learn from Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, or extract or collect any identified component for another purpose.
obligation_items.actor: licensee; end users and third parties whom the licensee allows
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, or Links
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using Grounding with Google Search, except where a specific permission in lines 249–276 applies to the particular action and material.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*   You will not, and will not allow your end user or any third party to, copy,
  store,
  or implement any click tracking, Link-tracking or other monitoring of Grounded
  Results or Search Suggestions, except that:
rules.actor_role: licensee, end users, and third parties whom the licensee allows
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: default prohibition on copying or storing Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, subject to the specific permissions in lines 249–271; line 244 also prohibits implementing click tracking, Link-tracking, or other monitoring, subject to the interface-monitoring permission in lines 273–276.
rules.condition_explanation: grounded_results_or_search_suggestions means the identified Search grounding content. The separately stated tracking/monitoring prohibition is limited by its exception at lines 273–276.

obligation_items.content: Do not copy or store Grounded Results or Search Suggestions except as permitted by the specific exceptions in lines 249–271; do not implement click tracking, Link-tracking, or other monitoring except as permitted by lines 273–276.
obligation_items.actor: licensee; end users and third parties whom the licensee allows
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results or Search Suggestions
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using Grounding with Google Search; the specified copy/store and interface-monitoring exceptions apply on their stated terms.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*     You may copy and store, for up to two (2) years, the text of the Grounded
    Result(s): (1) that were displayed by you only to evaluate and
    optimize the display of the Grounded Results in your application; (2)
    in chat history of an end user of your application
    only for the purpose of allowing that end user to view their chat history;
    and (3) temporarily for the purpose of resubmitting the text of the Grounded
    Result in a subsequent prompt that you submit to Google via a function call
    to obtain a refined or improved Grounded Result to display to the end user,
    as long as the developer: (i) does not use the interim Grounded Results for
    any other purpose; (ii) deletes any Grounded Result that is not displayed to
    the end user once the final Grounded Result is generated; and (iii) displays
    any associated Search Suggestions or other Links (as applicable) with the
    final Grounded Result (up to a maximum of 5 Search Suggestions) to the end
    user.
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permission to copy and store the specified text of Grounded Results for one of the listed purposes. The two-year limit applies to the listed storage permission; the function-call path is temporary and subject to its distinct conditions.
rules.condition_explanation: The three purposes are alternatives, not cumulative requirements. For the function-call alternative, all stated interim-use, deletion, and final-display conditions apply.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*     You may copy and store the Grounded Result and Search Suggestions solely for
    the purpose of and for the minimum time necessary to comply with applicable
    law or regulations.
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permission to copy and store Grounded Results and Search Suggestions solely to comply with applicable law or regulations, for the minimum time necessary.
rules.condition_explanation: Both the exclusive compliance purpose and minimum-necessary retention limit are required.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*     You may allow end user(s) to copy and store individual Grounded Results that
    were displayed to them through your application as long as you do not allow
    Grounded Results to be accessed or collected by automated or programmatic
    means or to be used to create a database.
rules.actor_role: licensee permitting end users to copy and store
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permission concerns individual Grounded Results displayed to end users through the application, subject to both access/collection and database restrictions.
rules.condition_explanation: All listed conditions apply to the end-user copy-and-store permission.

obligation_items.content: Ensure permitted end-user copies and stored results are not accessible or collected by automated or programmatic means and are not used to create a database.
obligation_items.object: individual Grounded Results displayed to end users through the application
obligation_items.trigger: When allowing end users to copy or store those results.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*     You may monitor end user interactions with your application interface;
    however, you will not track whether those interactions were specifically
    with a given Search Suggestion or Grounded Result (in each case, in whole or
    in part, including any specific Link).
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permits monitoring interactions with the application interface but not tracking whether interactions were specifically with a given Grounded Result, Search Suggestion, or Link, in whole or part.
rules.condition_explanation: The permission is for general interface interaction monitoring; the specific-content tracking exclusion applies to each identified content item or Link.

obligation_items.content: Do not track whether end-user interactions were specifically with a given Grounded Result, Search Suggestion, or Link, in whole or part.
obligation_items.object: end-user interactions with Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, or Links
obligation_items.trigger: When monitoring end-user interactions with the application interface.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
*   Unless permitted by Google in writing, you: (1) will not modify, or
  intersperse any other content with, the Grounded Results or Search
  Suggestions; and (2) will not place any interstitial content between any Link
  or Search Suggestions and the associated destination page, redirect end users
  away from the destination pages, or minimize, remove, or otherwise inhibit the
  full and complete display of any destination page.
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: absent Google's written permission, prohibits modifying or interspersing other content with Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, and prohibits specified interference with presentation or navigation from Links or Search Suggestions to associated destination pages.
rules.condition_explanation: google_has_not_permitted_in_writing is false if Google has given written permission. The restrictions concerning interstitial content, redirects, and inhibited destination-page display concern Links or Search Suggestions and associated destination pages.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify or intersperse other content with Grounded Results or Search Suggestions; do not place interstitial content between a Link or Search Suggestion and its associated destination page, redirect end users away from that page, or minimize, remove, or otherwise inhibit its full and complete display.
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, Links, and associated destination pages
obligation_items.trigger: Unless Google has permitted the conduct in writing.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
In addition to the general terms above ("How Google Uses Your Data" under
"[Unpaid Services](/docs/terms#unpaid-services)" and "[Paid Services](/docs/terms#paid-services)"),
when using Grounding with Google Search,
Google will store prompts, contextual information that you may provide, and
output for thirty (30) days for the purposes of creating Grounded Results and
Search Suggestions and the stored information can be used for debugging and
testing of systems that support Grounding with Google Search. When using
Grounding with Google Search via paid quota of Gemini API, this processing for
debugging and testing of systems is in accordance with the
[Data Processing Addendum for Products Where Google is a Data Processor](https://business.safety.google/processorterms/).
rules.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search data-use provision: Google states it will store prompts, provided contextual information, and output for 30 days to create Grounded Results and Search Suggestions; stored information can be used for debugging and testing. For use via paid Gemini API quota, debugging/testing processing is in accordance with the identified Data Processing Addendum. This records Google's stated service processing, not a grant of data rights to the licensee.
rules.condition_explanation: The 30-day storage and stated purposes apply when using Grounding with Google Search. The Data Processing Addendum qualification applies to debugging and testing processing when using paid Gemini API quota. The referenced addendum is not supplied, so its terms cannot be specified.

obligation_items.content: Store prompts, provided contextual information, and output for 30 days for creation of Grounded Results and Search Suggestions; stored information may be used for debugging and testing of supporting systems, with paid-quota debugging/testing processing governed by the referenced Data Processing Addendum.
obligation_items.object: prompts, contextual information provided, and output associated with Grounding with Google Search
obligation_items.trigger: When Grounding with Google Search is used; the Data Processing Addendum qualification applies to debugging and testing via paid Gemini API quota.

rules.license_id: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
source_aliases: Gemini API Additional Terms of Serv.txt
rules.source_excerpt:
1.   You will only use Grounding with Google Maps in an application that is owned
  and
  operated by you and will only use Grounding with Google Maps to display the
  Google Maps Grounded Results with the associated Google Maps Links to the
  end user who initiated the prompt. An end user is an individual you permit
